metadata.name: card_policy
metadata.description: ChainPay private agent card policy (MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollup)

accounts.name: intent
docs: intent maps to `IntentInvalid` instead of a generic account error.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: ValidatorNotAllowed
errors.msg: Validator is not on the TEE allowlist

errors.name: PolicyNotSet
errors.msg: Card policy has not been set

errors.name: IntentStale
errors.msg: Checkout intent was opened under an older policy

errors.name: MerchantMismatch
errors.msg: Merchant does not match the checkout intent

errors.name: MerchantNotAllowed
errors.msg: Merchant is not allowed by the card policy

errors.name: VelocityExceeded
errors.msg: Purchase count limit reached for this period

errors.name: DisclosureBlocked
errors.msg: Making card data public is blocked

errors.name: OutstandingBalance
errors.msg: Card has an outstanding statement balance

errors.name: AuthorizerChangeRequiresFreeze
errors.msg: Changing the authorizer requires a frozen card

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidAccount
errors.msg: Account does not belong to this card

errors.name: InvalidEventId
errors.msg: Event identifier must not be zero

types.name: CardBinding
docs: Base layer, never delegated, public. Owner <-> card link, no sensitive fields.

types.name: CardCommitment
docs: Base layer, never delegated, public. Written only by the checkpoint Magic Action.

types.name: CardPolicy
docs: Delegated to the TEE validator, private. Created zeroed on base apart from

fields.name: recon_digest
docs: Digest the owner signed in `restore`; `confirm_reconciled` must match it.

fields.name: repayment_digests
docs: Last statement digests passed to `record_repayment` (replay guard).

fields.name: event_ids
docs: Last issuer event ids applied by reverse/refund/dispute/exception/resolve.
Guards against a retried transaction landing twice.

types.name: CheckoutIntent
docs: PER-only ephemeral account, private. What the agent may buy, once.

types.name: Reservation
docs: PER-only ephemeral account, private. PDA existence is the replay guard.

fields.name: amount_reserved_cents
docs: Open hold still reserved against the budget.
